statements.notes: Directions: Mix 1 scoop with 6-8 fl. oz. of water or your favorite pre-workout or post-workout beverage. On rest days mix 1 scoop in your protein shake or water.

Benefits:
Helps provide energy to muscles.
Promotes ATP synthesis during intense exercise.
Helps muscle recovery in-between workout sessions.
Supports cognitive function.
Creatine Monohydrate supports sustained creatine loading.

Warning: not intended for anyone under the age of 18.
Keep out of reach of children.
